newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open tad easier on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open tad easier on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slipped at the opening on Wednesday, with profit-taking emerging after the previous day's steep gains, brokers said.
But they said the market would be underpinned by buying demand from domestic investment trusts.
The key Nikkei 225 average fell 61.49 points or 0.29 percent to stand at 21,249.10 at 0016 GMT. Its December futures shed 70 points to trade at 21,270.
"Since the pace of the rises over the last two trading days was a bit too fast, the market may take a breather today," said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
